defmodule CICDPipeline.WebhookHandler do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles incoming webhooks from GitHub/GitLab for CI/CD pipeline triggers.
  Deployed as a Kubernetes sidecar that validates and dispatches build jobs.
  """

  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:json],
    json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  @k8s_namespace System.get_env("K8S_NAMESPACE", "ci-builds")
  @allowed_registries ["gcr.io/our-project", "docker.io/ourorg"]

  post "/webhook/trigger" do
    with {:ok, payload} <- validate_signature(conn, conn.body_params),
         {:ok, job_spec} <- build_job_spec(payload),
         :ok <- dispatch_to_k8s(job_spec) do
      send_resp(conn, 202, Jason.encode!(%{status: "accepted"}))
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Webhook rejected: #{inspect(reason)}")
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "forbidden"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
  end

  defp validate_signature(conn, body_params) do
    secret = Application.get_env(:cicd_pipeline, :webhook_secret)
    sig_header = get_req_header(conn, "x-hub-signature-256") |> List.first()

    case sig_header do
      nil -> {:error, :missing_signature}
      sig ->
        raw_body = conn.assigns[:raw_body] || Jason.encode!(body_params)
        expected = "sha256=" <> (:crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, secret, raw_body) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower))
        if Plug.Crypto.secure_compare(expected, sig) do
          {:ok, body_params}
        else
          {:error, :invalid_signature}
        end
    end
  end

  defp build_job_spec(payload) do
    repo = get_in(payload, ["repository", "full_name"])
    ref = get_in(payload, ["ref"])
    commit = get_in(payload, ["after"])

    pipeline_config = fetch_pipeline_config(repo, ref)

    case pipeline_config do
      {:ok, config} when is_map(config) ->
        job_spec = %{
          "apiVersion" => "batch/v1",
          "kind" => "Job",
          "metadata" => %{
            "name" => "build-#{sanitize_name(repo)}-#{String.slice(commit || "", 0..7)}",
            "namespace" => @k8s_namespace,
            "labels" => %{"app" => "ci-build", "repo" => sanitize_name(repo)}
          },
          "spec" => build_pod_spec(config, repo, ref, commit)
        }
        {:ok, job_spec}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_config}
    end
  end

  defp build_pod_spec(config, repo, ref, commit) do
    container_image = resolve_image(config)
    env_vars = resolve_env_vars(config, repo, ref, commit)
    resource_limits = resolve_resources(config)

    %{
      "template" => %{
        "spec" => %{
          "containers" => [
            %{
              "name" => "build",
              "image" => container_image,
              "env" => env_vars,
              "resources" => resource_limits,
              "securityContext" => %{
                "runAsNonRoot" => true,
                "readOnlyRootFilesystem" => true,
                "allowPrivilegeEscalation" => false
              }
            }
          ],
          "restartPolicy" => "Never",
          "serviceAccountName" => "ci-runner-restricted"
        }
      }
    }
  end

  defp resolve_image(config) when is_map(config) do
    image = case config["image"] do
      img when is_binary(img) -> img
      _ -> "gcr.io/our-project/default-builder:latest"
    end
    validate_registry!(image)
    image
  end

  defp resolve_env_vars(config, repo, ref, commit) when is_map(config) do
    base_env = [
      %{"name" => "CI_REPO", "value" => repo || ""},
      %{"name" => "CI_REF", "value" => ref || ""},
      %{"name" => "CI_COMMIT", "value" => commit || ""}
    ]

    user_env = case config["env"] do
      vars when is_list(vars) -> Enum.flat_map(vars, &normalize_env_var_strict/1)
      vars when is_map(vars) ->
        Enum.flat_map(vars, fn
          {k, v} when is_binary(k) and is_binary(v) -> [%{"name" => k, "value" => v}]
          _ -> []
        end)
      _ -> []
    end

    base_env ++ filter_safe_env(user_env)
  end

  defp normalize_env_var_strict(var) when is_map(var) do
    name = var["name"]
    value = var["value"]
    if is_binary(name) and is_binary(value) do
      [%{"name" => name, "value" => value}]
    else
      []
    end
  end
  defp normalize_env_var_strict(_), do: []

  defp resolve_resources(config) when is_map(config) do
    limits = case config["resources"] do
      l when is_map(l) -> l
      _ -> %{}
    end
    %{
      "limits" => %{
        "cpu" => clamp_resource_strict(limits["cpu"], "2"),
        "memory" => clamp_resource_strict(limits["memory"], "4Gi")
      },
      "requests" => %{
        "cpu" => "100m",
        "memory" => "256Mi"
      }
    }
  end

  defp clamp_resource_strict(val, default) when is_binary(val) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[0-9]+(m|Mi|Gi|Ki)?$/, val), do: val, else: default
  end
  defp clamp_resource_strict(_, default), do: default

  defp validate_registry!(image) when is_binary(image) do
    unless Enum.any?(@allowed_registries, &String.starts_with?(image, &1)) do
      raise ArgumentError, "Image #{image} not from allowed registry"
    end
  end

  defp filter_safe_env(env_vars) when is_list(env_vars) do
    blocked_prefixes = ["K8S_", "KUBERNETES_", "AWS_", "GOOGLE_APPLICATION"]
    Enum.reject(env_vars, fn var ->
      name = var["name"] || ""
      Enum.any?(blocked_prefixes, &String.starts_with?(name, &1))
    end)
  end

  defp sanitize_name(nil), do: "unknown"
  defp sanitize_name(name) when is_binary(name) do
    name
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9-]/, "-")
    |> String.slice(0..62)
  end

  defp fetch_pipeline_config(repo, ref) do
    case CICDPipeline.ConfigStore.get(repo, ref) do
      nil -> {:error, :no_config}
      config when is_map(config) -> {:ok, config}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_config}
    end
  end

  defp dispatch_to_k8s(job_spec) do
    CICDPipeline.K8sClient.create_job(job_spec)
  end
end

defmodule CICDPipeline.ConfigStore do
  @moduledoc "Fetches and caches pipeline configurations from repos"

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  def init(_opts), do: {:ok, %{}}

  def get(repo, ref) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get, repo, ref})
  end

  def handle_call({:get, repo, ref}, _from, state) do
    key = "#{repo}:#{ref}"
    case Map.get(state, key) do
      nil ->
        config = fetch_from_repo(repo, ref)
        new_state = Map.put(state, key, config)
        {:reply, config, new_state}
      cached ->
        {:reply, cached, state}
    end
  end

  defp fetch_from_repo(repo, ref) do
    # Simulates fetching .ci-pipeline.json from the repository
    # In production this calls the Git provider API
    case CICDPipeline.GitProvider.fetch_file(repo, ref, ".ci-pipeline.json") do
      {:ok, content} when is_binary(content) ->
        case Jason.decode(content) do
          {:ok, parsed} when is_map(parsed) -> parsed
          _ -> nil
        end
      _ -> nil
    end
  end
end

defmodule CICDPipeline.K8sClient do
  @moduledoc "Kubernetes API client for job management"

  require Logger

  @api_server System.get_env("KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST", "kubernetes.default.svc")
  @token_path "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token"

  def create_job(job_spec) do
    namespace = get_in(job_spec, ["metadata", "namespace"])
    token = read_sa_token()

    url = "https://#{@api_server}/apis/batch/v1/namespaces/#{namespace}/jobs"

    headers = [
      {"Authorization", "Bearer #{token}"},
      {"Content-Type", "application/json"}
    ]

    body = Jason.encode!(job_spec)

    case HTTPoison.post(url, body, headers, ssl: k8s_ssl_opts()) do
      {:ok, %{status_code: code}} when code in [200, 201] -> :ok
      {:ok, %{status_code: code, body: resp}} ->
        Logger.error("K8s API error #{code}: #{resp}")
        {:error, :k8s_api_error}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("K8s connection error: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, :k8s_connection_error}
    end
  end

  defp read_sa_token do
    case File.read(@token_path) do
      {:ok, token} -> String.trim(token)
      {:error, _} -> raise "Cannot read service account token"
    end
  end

  defp k8s_ssl_opts do
    [cacertfile: "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt", verify: :verify_peer]
  end
end
